Test fixtures for the server-side FBX import (src/server/AgentV3/gameAssets/userModels.ts), both CC0 1.0 Universal:
- pig.fbx   — Quaternius, Farm Animal Pack (June 2018), Pig.fbx. https://quaternius.com/packs/farmanimal.html
              Animated (Idle, Jump); its materials load as fully transparent through FBXLoader — the defect the import fixes.
- sword.fbx — Kay Lousberg, KayKit Adventurers Character Pack 2.0, Assets/fbx(unity)/sword_1handed.fbx (License.txt: CC0).
              References a texture file, which made FBXLoader call browser APIs in Node and fail to parse.
